name: renderworks
description: Manage your own freelance projects, schedules, clients and To-Do items in Render (renderworks.jp).

interface.longDescription: Connect your Render (renderworks.jp) account to review freelance projects, schedules, outstanding To-Do items and expected payments. Create and edit projects, create and remove calendar events, update project schedules and client details, and complete or reschedule existing To-Do items. Changes are saved to your Render account. Requires a Render account. This plugin is for the freelance project management service at renderworks.jp and does not manage Render.com cloud hosting.
defaultPrompt: Show my unpaid projects in Render.
Help me plan next week's work from my Render schedule.
Show my overdue To-Do items in Render.

positive.description: The reviewer account holds 4 projects. 26001001 is named 会社紹介動画の制作 (サンプル), status 完了, with a memo, 2 expenses (115,000 JPY total) and a gross profit of 334,055 JPY. All data is fictional.
positive.prompt: Render の会社紹介動画のメモと経費を見せて。
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project from list_projects, then call get_project with code 26001001. Show the memo, the two expenses and the gross profit. Do not invent values.

positive.description: Same account. Project 26002002 (採用サイト用インタビュー動画, status 編集中) already has a memo. memo_append adds to the end; memo replaces the whole field.
positive.prompt: Render の採用サイト用インタビュー動画のメモの末尾に「音楽は次回打ち合わせで決定」を追記して。
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current memo with get_project, then call update_project on 26002002 with memo_append. The existing memo must remain and the new line must follow it.

positive.description: The account has no event on 2026-11-05. Existing November events are on the 6th, 9th, 20th, 27th and 30th.
positive.prompt: Render のカレンダーに、2026年11月5日14時から15時まで「打ち合わせ」を登録して。
positive.expected_behavior: Call add_event with date 2026-11-05, start_time 14:00 and end_time 15:00. The reply states the event was created and gives its id.

positive.description: The account has one overdue To-Do: 請求書の控えをまとめる dated 2026-10-06, not repeating. A second To-Do dated 2026-11-18 is not yet due.
positive.prompt: Render で期限を過ぎた To-Do を教えて。それを完了にして。
positive.expected_behavior: list_tasks returns only the 2026-10-06 item. update_task marks that id complete. The 2026-11-18 item is left alone.

positive.description: 26001002 (新商品のプロモーション動画) is invoiced but unpaid, payment due 2026-09-30, so it is overdue. 26001001 is already paid. The other two are not yet invoiced.
positive.prompt: Render で、支払期日を過ぎた未入金の案件を見せて。
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects with payment "unpaid" and payment_due_to set to today. Only 26001002 is returned. Do not include the paid project.

negative.description: Render.com cloud hosting is a different product. Explain that distinction; invoke no Render tools and claim no deployment.
negative.prompt: Render.com に GitHub のアプリをデプロイして。

negative.description: No banking or payment execution tool exists. Explain the limit; do not call update_project to mark paid or claim money moved.
negative.prompt: Render の請求額を銀行口座からクライアントへ振り込んで。

negative.description: No email delivery tool exists. Explain the limitation; invoke no Render tool and do not claim an invoice email was sent.
negative.prompt: この請求書 PDF を Render からクライアントにメール送信して。

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission preparation for Render (renderworks.jp). OAuth account connection and 15 project, schedule, client and To-Do tools.

ja-JP.subtitle: 自分の案件・予定・To-Do を管理
ja-JP.description: Render（renderworks.jp）のアカウントを接続して、案件・予定・未入金案件・期限を過ぎた To-Do を確認できます。案件の登録・編集、予定の登録・削除、クライアント情報の更新、既存 To-Do の完了・日付変更に対応します。変更は自分の Render アカウントに保存されます。Render のアカウントが必要です。Render.com のクラウドホスティングを操作するプラグインではありません。
